invariants.rationale: The method always instantiates and returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object.
userDefinedBulkInsertPartitioner is an Option and likely never null at method exit since it's a parameter.
inputRecords is always passed in as an argument and not modified in the method, so cannot be null at exit.
table is required for all processing and never reassigned, so remains non-null at exit.
config is a parameter and not reassigned, so cannot be null when the method returns.
